instruction: Look at drill_plate.step in SolidCAM. Recognize the four marked hole locations on drill_plate.step. Use T1 for Center Drill or Spot Drill, and use T2 for Drill. All holes must break through the bottom by 1 mm. Use T1 at S8000 rpm and F250 mm/min, and T2 at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min. Tool definitions: T1 is a center/spot drill at S8000 rpm and F250 mm/min; T2 is a 5 mm drill at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-3.nc.
source: SolidCAM Professor 中含 Creating Drill Geometries、Drill Recognition 等内容：https://solidcam.com/professor-video/ (SolidCAM)
